title: An optimized protocol for the retroviral transduction of mouse CD4 T cells
protocol: Coat 10 cm plates by adding 5 mL of 50 μg/mL poly-D-lysine in sterile water.
Incubate the coated plates at 22°C for 45 min.
Wash the plates twice with sterile water.
Aspirate the culture medium from Plat-E cells previously cultured in a 75 cm² flask.
Add 2 mL pre-warmed trypsin-EDTA 0.05% to the cells and incubate at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂-containing incubator for 3–5 min until detached.
Wash the cells out with 8 mL medium and collect the supernatant in a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells twice at 500 × g for 5 min, replacing the supernatant with fresh medium each time.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed Plat-E cells in the coated plates, 3 × 10⁶ cells per plate.
Incubate the seeded cells for 16 h at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂-containing incubator.
Replace the medium with 10 mL DMEM medium supplemented with 10% (v/v) FBS and 1 mg/mL streptomycin, 100 U/mL penicillin when Plat-E cells are 85%-90% confluent.
Add the required volume of DMEM without supplements to each 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 15 μg of pMP71Gpre GFP plasmid DNA to one Eppendorf tube.
Add 45 μL Lipofectamine to another Eppendorf tube.
Transfer the diluted Lipofectamine to the diluted DNA solution.
Pipette up and down 3–4 times immediately after mixing.
Incubate at 22°C for 20 minutes to allow Lipofectamine/DNA complexes to form.
Mix well after incubation.
Add the complex mixture dropwise to Plat-E plates.
Gently swirl the plate.
Incubate for 16 hours at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 containing incubator.
Replace the medium with DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS and antibiotics.
Check the fluorescence of transfected Plat-E cells to determine transfection efficiency.
Sacrifice male or female C57BL/6 mice aged 8–12 weeks with an overdose of isoflurane.
Harvest the spleens into a 10 cm petri-dish filled with 5 mL HBSS.
In a BSC2 hood, wash the spleens in 5 mL HBSS in a 10 cm plate.
Transfer the washed spleens to a 70 μm cell strainer, placed within a 10 cm plate, with 4 mL HBSS.
Using the ridged side of a 3 ml syringe plunger mash the spleens through the cell strainer.
Rinse with 10 mL HBSS and transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the HBSS and add 300 μL ACK lysing buffer per spleen.
Gently mix with the pellet and incubate for 1 min at 22°C.
Add 10 mL HBSS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
If the pellet remains red after centrifugation, remove the HBSS and add 150 μL ACK lysing buffer per spleen.
Incubate at 22°C for 45 s.
Add 10 mL HBSS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the HBSS and wash twice by adding 10 mL HBSS.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C after each wash.
Isolate CD4 T cells using the EasySep Mouse CD4 T Cell Isolation Kit as per manufacturer's instructions.
Count CD4 T cells using a hemocytometer and bring to a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells per mL in complete RMPI medium.
Wash Dynabeads™ Mouse T-Activator CD3/CD28 in an Eppendorf tube with washing buffer by pipetting five times.
Place the Eppendorf on a DynaMag™ Magnet for 1 minute and remove the supernatant.
Suspend washed Dynabeads™ in culture medium to match the initial volume of Dynabeads™ taken.
Add 25 μL of Dynabeads™ per 1 × 10^6 CD4 T cells.
Seed 1 × 10^6 cells per well in a 24-well plate and incubate at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2-containing incubator for 16–18 hours.
Coat non-treated 24-well plates with PBS containing 20 μg/mL RetroNectin®.
Incubate coated plates for 2 hours at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2-containing incubator.
Harvest the viral supernatant from transfected Plat-E cells.
Centrifuge the harvested supernatant at 800 × g for 10 minutes.
Filtrate through a 0.45 μm filter.
Replace with 500 μL per well of PBS supplemented with 2% (w/v) BSA.
Incubate at 20°C–22°C for 30 minutes.
Wash twice with PBS.
Remove all BSA from each well before washing.
Wash the wells twice with 1 mL of PBS.
Ensure all liquid is removed from the wells after washing.
Add 1 mL of viral supernatant per well to washed plates.
Wrap the plates in plastic wrap and centrifuge at 2000 × g for 4 hours at 32°C.
Two hours prior to end, add 80 IU/mL of recombinant IL-2 to CD4 T cells.
Collect cells into 15 mL conical tubes after centrifugation for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and store at 22°C for up to 1 hour.
Remove Dynabeads™ using a DynaMag™ Magnet.
Suspend the collected cells in stored supernatant.
Add 1 mL of CD4 T cell suspension per well containing 1 × 10^6 cells.
Re-wrap the plate in plastic wrap and centrifuge at 800 × g for 30 minutes at 32°C.
Remove plastic wrap and store plates at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 incubator.
Expand transduced CD4 T cells in culture in complete RPMI medium supplemented with 20 IU of IL-2 and 10 ng/mL IL-7.
Remove 500 μL from each well after 48 h and add 500 μL complete RPMI medium supplemented with 20 IU of IL-2 and 10 ng/mL IL-7.
Collect cells 72 h post transduction for cell sorting using the FACSAria™ III Cell Sorter.
Seed sorted cells, 1 × 10^6 cells per well, in a 24-well plate in complete RPMI medium supplemented with 20 IU of IL-2 and 10 ng/mL IL-7.
Activate sorted cells 48 h post cell sorting with Dynabeads™ Mouse T-Activator CD3/CD28 in complete RPMI medium.
Remove 500 μL of medium from cells 48 hours post cell activation.
Replace with 500 μL of complete RPMI supplemented with 20 IU IL-2 and 10 ng/mL IL-7.
Every 2 days, while cells are proliferating, carefully pipette and split one well to two.
Add 500 μL of fresh complete RPMI supplemented with 20 IU IL-2 and 10 ng/mL IL-7.
Once the cells are resting, replace half of the medium with fresh medium every second day.
Activate cells with Dynabeads™ every 7–10 days, as required.
